contract: one text file read from memory: one text per line, upper-case hexadecimal code points, each optionally with line starts

as libass 0.17.5's ass_shaper_shape and ass_shaper_reorder with whole-text layout: FriBidi 1.0.17's bidi types (and bracket types when the case pairs brackets), embedding levels per paragraph (each ending after a BS character) with the case's base direction, then fribidi_reorder_line with flags 0 over each line (ending before each line start, after each BS character and at the end)
per line: its length, each paragraph's resolved direction, the levels after reordering and the visual-to-logical map; packets count lines and bytes code points
a line that does not parse is recorded as such; the file is read before each timed and memory operation
